scope: Optional art resources. No shop/equip integration.

corsair.name: Corsair
corsair.description: Timber plating, canvas fin panels, braided rigging, portholes and broadside cannon housings.

overgrown.name: Overgrown
overgrown.description: Living armor: coral and barnacles on fish, climbing vines and blossoms on birds.

entries.name: Sardine
features: Timber-patterned plating and canvas decorative panels
Four broadside cannon housings with recessed dark muzzle faces
Braided rope rails and brass-rimmed portholes
Triangle faction insignias in texture and raised geometry
Triangle marks on both forward flanks

entries.name: Sardine
features: Original animal hull stays visible beneath living surface detail
Paired branching coral gardens follow the fish shoulders
Raised barnacle colonies with recessed openings
Moss-patterned enamel and restrained warm organic accents
